# Gaps found by the fuzz targets of spec loop round 3 (loop_r3_fuzz_test.go).
FuzzIsHomePositions catch:free compiler VIP-5: a typed catch parameter in plain code reports EK2105 and EK9203, though decided detail 249's examples use that native form; lane impl-hunt-data

FuzzIsHomePositions catch:local-do compiler VIP-4/VIP-5: the catch-local-do shape throws from a plain function, which EK0401 rejects, and its untyped catch parameter is unknown outside effect code (TS2339), so no plain wrapper can host the do-block default; lane impl-hunt-data
